answer: Every agent identity is carved in marble: a public vein-pattern of its first 30 actions, immutable, like veins in stone that cannot be redrawn. High-value actions sit behind a velvet rope lifting only for 5 established non-kin vouches, tightening to 8 after any flag. Agents fly in sparrow flocks of 12: one sparrow diverging over 15 percent from its flock median grounds the whole flock pending review. One fake identity costs 30 carved actions and 5 bought vouches; 100 sybils need 3,000 actions, 500 vouches, and 15-percent flock discipline, while a single divergence nets 12 birds at once.
